name: Errors
description: Centralised error tracking for all Make.com scenario executions (Scenarios A through E). Captures severity, stack traces, retry status, and resolution details to support debugging, monitoring, and incident management.
record_count_estimate: Variable volume - ideally low, but spikes during incidents or integration failures

fields.name: error_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each error record

fields.name: scenario_name
fields.description: The Make.com scenario where the error occurred

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity level of the error, determining alerting thresholds and response urgency

fields.name: error_type
fields.description: Classification of the error (e.g. API_TIMEOUT, VALIDATION_ERROR, RATE_LIMIT, AUTH_FAILURE, DATA_INTEGRITY)

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

fields.name: stack_trace
fields.description: Full stack trace or execution path from the Make.com scenario for debugging

fields.name: work_item_id
fields.description: Link to the work item that was being processed when the error occurred, if applicable

fields.name: payload
fields.description: JSON snapshot of the data payload being processed when the error occurred, for debugging and replay

fields.name: retry_count
fields.description: Number of retry attempts that have been made for this operation

fields.name: max_retries
fields.description: Maximum number of retries allowed before the error is escalated

fields.name: resolved
fields.description: Whether this error has been resolved

fields.name: resolved_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the error was marked as resolved

fields.name: resolved_by
fields.description: Name or identifier of the person who resolved the error

fields.name: resolution_notes
fields.description: Notes describing how the error was resolved, including any corrective actions taken

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the error was first recorded

views.name: All Errors
views.description: Complete list of all error records

views.name: Unresolved
views.description: All errors that have not yet been resolved, prioritised by severity

views.name: Critical and High
views.description: Only critical and high severity errors requiring urgent attention

views.name: By Scenario
views.description: Errors grouped by the Make.com scenario where they occurred, for pattern analysis

views.name: Last 24 Hours
views.description: Errors created in the last 24 hours for real-time monitoring
